details.layout: sandwich: motherboard/cooler on front side; riser-mounted GPU and compact 1U PSU on rear side
details.storage: M.2 only; no separate drive bays
details.ventilation: large perforated side panels; no front ventilation
details.front_panel: solid removable magnetic panel with power-button opening only
details.panel_fit: front, rear, left and right panels extend flush between the top cap and base with no exposed inner-frame gaps
details.perimeter_panel_retention: tool-less magnetic retention for front, rear, left and right panels; no perimeter-panel screws
details.magnet_spec: 15 x 10 x 4 mm rectangular adhesive magnet; 15.2 x 10.2 x 4.1 mm direct notch shaved into corner posts; no separate carrier or screw passage; four stations per perimeter panel, 16 total; end-panel and side-panel magnets use staggered heights
details.rear_panel_mounting: magnet stations and locating features must not intrude into motherboard, GPU or PSU service apertures

notes: User provided images of a dual-fan, dual-slot GPU. The current mechanical evaluation retains the 180 x 115 x 40 mm concept envelope because the images do not provide a verifiable complete dimensional drawing. Final print release requires physical GPU measurements.
